nda24fcf310.headline: Azerbaijan to allocate AZN 77 million from unemployment fund to boost self-employment in 2026
nda24fcf310.summary: Azerbaijan projects allocating 77 million manats from the Unemployment Insurance Fund in 2026 to support self-employment. The figure was discussed in parliamentary committees on the 2026 state budget.
nda24fcf310.why: Government labour programmes funded from social insurance pools affect public spending and labour market conditions.

n5ca9d1b0d0.headline: Zohran Mamdani’s new NYC agenda: Can his rent freeze and free bus promise really make New York affordable again? Here’s what we know
n5ca9d1b0d0.summary: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani's agenda includes a four-year rent freeze, free buses and higher corporate taxes. Experts question the cost of the proposals.
n5ca9d1b0d0.why: Rent regulation and corporate tax policy in New York City affect real estate investors, landlords and companies headquartered in the city.

n6b4f37f3c2.headline: COP30: What does the ‘Baku to Belém roadmap’ mean for climate finance?
n6b4f37f3c2.summary: Carbon Brief details what the Baku to Belém roadmap is, why it was launched and its key points on climate finance. The roadmap was presented at COP30.
n6b4f37f3c2.why: Climate finance commitments direct large public and private capital flows toward energy transition and adaptation projects.

ndad6ff7f6c.headline: Kenya seeks to attract over Ksh.258 billion in new investment by 2028
ndad6ff7f6c.summary: President William Ruto witnessed a memorandum of understanding between Kenya's Nairobi International Financial Centre Authority and the Qatar Financial Centre. The deal seeks over USD 2 billion in investment by 2028.
ndad6ff7f6c.why: Financial-centre partnerships like this aim to channel foreign capital into a host economy and build cross-border financial services, which matters for investors tracking frontier-market capital flows.

n025085c01e.headline: Former Oil Undersecretary: Sudan ordered shutdown prep due to drone threat
n025085c01e.summary: A former South Sudanese Undersecretary of Petroleum said Sudanese authorities on October 24 told them to prepare safe shutdowns due to recent drone attacks near oil facilities.
n025085c01e.why: Sudan and South Sudan share oil infrastructure and pipelines, so disruptions to production or transit can affect regional crude supply and the economies that depend on oil revenue.

n84058d789f.summary: Arm Holdings plc's American Depositary Shares held a call to discuss forecasts, targets and financial results. The transcript covers forward-looking statements about the company.
n84058d789f.why: Arm is a UK chip-design company whose processor architecture is licensed widely in smartphones and data centres, so its guidance is closely watched by semiconductor investors.

n016b04e17f.summary: Woodside Energy plans to lift oil and gas sales by 50% by 2032 through LNG and crude projects in Australia, the US and Mexico. The growth plan is described as a bet on the LNG boom.
n016b04e17f.why: Woodside is one of Australia's largest independent oil and gas producers and a major LNG exporter. Its production plans influence global LNG supply and Australian energy exports.

n03f88efa9d.headline: Africa braces for impact of EU carbon border tax
n03f88efa9d.summary: Europe's carbon border tax is set to affect the competitiveness of many types of African exports to the European Union. The measure targets carbon-intensive imports.
n03f88efa9d.why: The EU carbon border adjustment mechanism applies carbon costs to certain imports, affecting exporters into the European market.

n7607a8bab9.headline: A declaration of famine is rare. It's now happened twice in 2025, this time in Sudan
n7607a8bab9.summary: International hunger monitors declared that regions of war-torn Sudan face catastrophic food shortages. Famine declarations are rare, and this is the second in 2025.
n7607a8bab9.why: Food insecurity in conflict zones affects regional food prices, humanitarian funding and the outlook for agricultural trade.

n0831a44bd8.headline: Households rely on consumer credit more than ever before in Spain
n0831a44bd8.summary: Outstanding consumer credit debt of Spanish households exceeds €110 billion for the first time, after rising 10% in September. The debt-to-GDP ratio remains at controlled levels.
n0831a44bd8.why: Household credit trends influence consumer spending and bank lending volumes, which affect Spain's economic growth and banks' loan books.

nfbbf16925e.headline: New data exposes what Aussies are sacrificing to get a home loan - realestate.com.au
nfbbf16925e.summary: New data shows Australian homebuyers are sacrificing spending on dining out and digital subscriptions, and even family plans, as banks scrutinise spending habits closely.
nfbbf16925e.why: Mortgage lending standards and household budgets shape Australia's housing market and consumer spending, which are key drivers of its economy.

n1a1e47b991.headline: Parsons:  Q3 Earnings Snapshot
n1a1e47b991.summary: Parsons Corp. reported third-quarter earnings of $64.1 million on Wednesday. The Chantilly, Virginia-based company also reported per-share profit.
n1a1e47b991.why: Parsons is a US defense and government technology contractor, so its quarterly results indicate demand from government and defense customers.

nf0502a7b7c.headline: الأسهم تفقد 142 نقطة.. المؤشر عند 11,257
nf0502a7b7c.summary: The main Saudi stock market index fell 142 points, or 1.2%, to close at 11,257. The close was its lowest in more than a month.
nf0502a7b7c.why: Tadawul, Saudi Arabia's main exchange, is the largest bourse in the Arab world, so its index moves reflect regional investor sentiment.
nf0502a7b7c.why_moved: The index fell 1.2% to its lowest close in more than a month, as reported; the input gives no specific cause.

n007b79ffd0.headline: Yes, Trump's tariffs are raising billions -- but at a steep economic cost
n007b79ffd0.summary: Trump's tariffs are raising tens of billions of dollars for the federal government. The measures are also costing consumers, frustrating businesses and hurting the factories they are meant to help.
n007b79ffd0.why: Tariffs are taxes on imported goods that affect input costs, trade flows and inflation. Their scale and duration shape corporate margins and the outlook for US growth.

n93b7abd614.headline: US motor vehicle sales drop in October as EV subsidies expire
n93b7abd614.summary: US light vehicle sales fell 6.5% in October following the expiration of federal electric vehicle subsidies, raising concerns about consumer demand.
n93b7abd614.why: Vehicle sales are a closely watched gauge of US consumer spending, and automakers' volumes depend heavily on incentives and financing conditions.

n9e8ecfd4d0.headline: Statement By Dr George Elombi On the Occasion of His Investiture As President and Chairman of the African Export-Import Bank
n9e8ecfd4d0.summary: Dr George Elombi was invested as President and Chairman of the African Export-Import Bank. Nigerian Finance Minister Wale Edun chaired the general meeting of shareholders.
n9e8ecfd4d0.why: Afreximbank is a multilateral lender financing trade and investment across Africa, so its leadership shapes its lending priorities.

n4c82eb9f37.summary: BYD's inventories in Australia are much larger than those of other major brands, as the company accumulates credits under new emissions regulations. A report says the rules create a loophole.
n4c82eb9f37.why: BYD is a Chinese electric vehicle maker and a major exporter, and Australia's new fuel-efficiency rules affect how carmakers source imports.

impacts.why: Accumulated emissions credits under the new Australian rules could benefit BYD's sales of imported vehicles.

n7b688f9f91.why: Joint commissions set the agenda for bilateral trade and investment cooperation between governments.

n28708bd34a.headline: Supreme Court enters the lion's den on Trump tariffs
n28708bd34a.summary: The US Supreme Court is hearing a case on Trump tariffs. The case has potentially profound economic consequences for the country and the presidency.
n28708bd34a.why: The Supreme Court's rulings can determine whether presidential tariff powers stand, shaping trade costs for importers and exporters.

n0d46d427c3.headline: Tinubu Seeks Reps' Approval For N1.15trn Loan To Finance Budget Deficit
n0d46d427c3.summary: President Bola Tinubu has asked the House of Representatives to approve borrowing of N1.15 trillion to finance a budget deficit. The request was made in a letter to the House.
n0d46d427c3.why: Government borrowing to fund deficits affects Nigeria's debt levels, bond yields and the naira.

n0af4f62259.headline: Ringgit closes higher vs greenback ahead of OPR announcement tomorrow
n0af4f62259.summary: The ringgit closed higher against the US dollar on Wednesday ahead of the Overnight Policy Rate announcement due the next day. The rate decision is set for Thursday.
n0af4f62259.why: The Overnight Policy Rate is set by Bank Negara Malaysia, the central bank, and influences borrowing costs and the ringgit. Investors watch the decision for signals on monetary policy.

na6c76345d8.headline: Gold prices in world markets increased by 40% in third quarter
na6c76345d8.summary: The average gold price in world markets rose 40% year-on-year in the third quarter, to 3,456. The report covers the quarter's average price.
na6c76345d8.why: Gold is a traditional store of value and a key asset for central banks and investors. Its price reflects inflation expectations, currency moves and risk demand.

n5d01e1bfda.why: The One Big Beautiful Bill is the 2025 US federal legislation that changed tax and spending policy, and its provisions affect household finances and federal revenue.

n6e9ecc0540.summary: Australia has added Reddit and Kick to its list of social media platforms that must ban children under 16 from having accounts. The platforms now fall under the age restriction.
n6e9ecc0540.why: Reddit is a US-listed online community platform whose user base and advertising revenue depend on account access. Age-based rules can affect user growth and compliance costs.

nfdd847208c.summary: The federal government shutdown has stretched into the record books as the longest in U.S. history. Americans are reporting worsening impacts from the closure.

nd81c96e68f.why: Bitcoin treasury companies hold bitcoin on their balance sheets, linking corporate capital flows to the crypto market.

n2104f792ff.headline: Pakistan’s Unemployment Rate Hits 7.8 Pc, Leaving 18.7 Million Jobless Amid Deepening Youth Crisis
n2104f792ff.summary: Pakistan's unemployment rate reached 7.8%, leaving 18.7 million people jobless. Among the economically active population, the rate is 11%, reflecting a deepening youth jobs crisis.
n2104f792ff.why: Unemployment and labour-market slack influence consumer demand and the economic and political pressures facing the government.

n54548cc8ae.headline: Canadian Lodging Outlook Quarterly 2025-Q3
n54548cc8ae.summary: HVS and STR have released their quarterly Canadian Lodging Outlook for 2025-Q3. The report covers occupancy, average daily rate and revenue per available room in six major markets.
n54548cc8ae.why: Hotel occupancy and room rates are key indicators of tourism and business travel demand, and they feed into the performance of lodging owners and operators.

n9d3b73e75c.summary: Chinese fast-fashion brand Shein has opened its first-ever physical store in Paris, located in the BHV building, according to ANSA.
n9d3b73e75c.why: Shein is a large online fast-fashion retailer, and its move into bricks-and-mortar retail signals a shift in its distribution strategy.

nbe36fbff09.headline: Qatar’s Al-Thani Group Signals Port Qasim Stake Divestment as Pakistan’s FDI Crisis Deepens
nbe36fbff09.summary: Qatar's Al-Thani Group has signaled it intends to sell its 49% stake in the $2.09 billion, 1,320-megawatt Port Qasim coal-fired power plant.
nbe36fbff09.why: Foreign direct investment into Pakistan's power sector affects foreign-exchange inflows and the financial health of independent power producers.

n0b3546b226.headline: Pakistan’s trade gap widens 56pc in October as imports surge
n0b3546b226.summary: Pakistan's goods trade deficit widened about 55.9% year on year in October 2025 to $3.21 billion as imports jumped and exports slipped.
n0b3546b226.why: Trade deficits pressure Pakistan's foreign-exchange reserves and the rupee, which matters for its sovereign debt and external financing.

n4786cd53c1.headline: Wall Street gains ground amid steady flow of earnings reports, upbeat economic updates
n4786cd53c1.summary: US stocks gained ground after several upbeat economic updates and a steady flow of quarterly reports from American companies.
n4786cd53c1.why: The S&P 500 tracks the largest US listed companies, so its daily moves reflect shifts in economic data and earnings expectations.
n4786cd53c1.why_moved: Stocks rose after several upbeat economic updates and a steady flow of quarterly reports from U.S. companies.

n76cea27248.headline: Inflation holds steady at 1.7% in October 2025 amid slower rise in food prices
n76cea27248.summary: Philippine inflation held steady at 1.7% in October 2025, as slower food inflation offset a surge in electricity rates.
n76cea27248.why: Inflation trends guide the central bank's interest rate decisions, which influence Philippine bond yields and the peso.

n347bd95e4c.headline: Soybeans Back to Gains on Wednesday
n347bd95e4c.summary: Soybeans were up 6 to 9 cents across most contracts on Wednesday. Soymeal futures rose $5.70, while the national average cash bean price was 7.75 cents lower at $10.54.
n347bd95e4c.why: Soybeans are a major agricultural commodity traded on the Chicago Board of Trade, with prices feeding into food and animal feed markets worldwide.

n3d0cccac25.headline: Financial stability risks elevated despite resilient global economy, strong investment sentiments: MAS
n3d0cccac25.summary: The Monetary Authority of Singapore said financial stability risks are elevated despite a resilient global economy and strong investment sentiment. Corporates, households and the financial sector remain buoyant.
n3d0cccac25.why: The Monetary Authority of Singapore is the city-state's central bank and financial regulator.

n1707b125eb.headline: Justices question Trump tariffs as Supreme Court weighs keeping them: Top takeaways
n1707b125eb.summary: Justices questioned whether Trump has the power to impose tariffs on most imports, as the Supreme Court weighs keeping them. The questions reveal where the justices stand on the policy.
n1707b125eb.why: Tariffs on imports affect trade costs, corporate margins and inflation, and court rulings can determine whether they remain in force.
n1707b125eb.why_moved: Justices' skepticism over the president's tariff authority raises the prospect that the tariffs could be curtailed, which bears on trade costs for importers.

n1f823c4e72.headline: Budget signals tone shift on oil and gas, but key details still unclear: experts
n1f823c4e72.summary: The federal budget signals a shift in tone toward the oil and gas sector, but experts say many details on how this will play out remain unknown.
n1f823c4e72.why: Oil and gas policy shapes investment in Canada's energy producers, pipelines and export capacity, which are major contributors to the economy and to the Canadian dollar.
